briefs.claim_en: Two crocodiles were seen in Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysuru yesterday evening.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple sources report past crocodile sightings in Kukkarahalli Lake, Mysuru. The Hindu reported a giant marsh crocodile on the lake bund on March 26, 2010. Star of Mysore reported a crocodile sighting on September 7, 2023, and another on December 1, 2024, near Hunsur Main Road. On January 28, 2026, a crocodile was again spotted at the lake bank, and the lake is known to be a crocodile habitat with warning signs. An article from March 3, 2024, mentions people seeing something in the northern part of the lake during an evening walk. Facebook reports also mention a crocodile being spotted during an evening walk, though it's not a commonly documented feature.
gaps_en: No evidence specifically reports two crocodiles being seen in Kukkarahalli Lake on October 8, 2026.
The provided evidence consists of past sightings and general information about the lake, not a specific report for the claimed date.
